peer_reviewed_primary_sources.qualification_note: Journal/proceedings publication does not by itself establish peer review. Macquarie explicitly labels Quinn's item as peer-reviewed. Clarkson's official author page establishes conference publication but not its review process.

errors_omissions_and_limits: All three pilot reports stay within the stated per-report limits (r733 13/16 total, 8/8 queries, 5/10 opens; r672 16/16, 8/8, 8/10; r806 10/16, 5/8, 5/10). Their source checks are incomplete where they say so; no original operation-limit breach was found.

r733 F1 page-specific Rife passage and access level are not backed by a logged open; the report search operation says only that excerpts were found. Reviewer independently opened a third-party scan and verified the passage, but this remains a source-log coverage deficiency.
A few reports discuss empirical coverage as an engineering implication. None of the inspected academic abstracts or passages gives a calibrated confidence method for this receiver.
The receiver packet excerpts are not performance evidence; H06's finite Gaussian fixture and generated-path example cannot establish general false-admission rates or the proposed 95% target.

No supplied or verified academic result establishes whether <=0.10 Hz by six seconds at >=95% is feasible for the stated reference levels, offsets, waveform activity, or chunk delivery. Reference/noise bandwidth mapping, envelope duty cycle, actual interference, phase coherence, and evolution remain open.
Terra-retention/rejection and expert-review stage statuses were absent from the assigned artifacts and were not assessed; no finding is silently marked accepted by those stages.
acceptance_limit: Independent source verification of the three assigned pilot cases only. No prompt comparison, winner selection, project run, or claim about unassigned reports.
